1.web: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
1.asv: It is actually reported that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not even among the Gentiles, that oneof you hath his father’s wife.

2.web: You are puffed up, and didn’t rather mourn, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
2.asv: And ye are puffed up, and did not rather mourn, that he that had done this deed might be taken away from among you.

3.web: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
3.asv: For I verily, being absent in body but present in spirit, have already as though I were present judged him that hath so wrought this thing,

4.web: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
4.asv: in the name of our Lord Jesus, ye being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus,

5.web: are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
5.asv: to deliver such a one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

6.web: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
6.asv: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

7.web: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
7.asv: Purge out the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, even as ye are unleavened. For our passover also hath been sacrificed, even Christ:

8.web: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
8.asv: wherefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

9.web: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
9.asv: I wrote unto you in my epistle to have no company with fornicators;

10.web: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters; for then you would have to leave the world.
10.asv: not at all meaning with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world:

11.web: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
11.asv: but as it is, I wrote unto you not to keep company, if any man that is named a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such a one no, not to eat.

12.web: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
12.asv: For what have I to do with judging them that are without? Do not ye judge them that are within?

13.web: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
13.asv: But them that are without God judgeth. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
